Head_and_Face: Elongated head with large dark eyes and mobile ears.
Erect bristly mane on arched neck.
Body_and_Plumage: Fleet equine body with tall, athletic proportions at the withers.
Distinctive black-and-white striped coat pattern unique to each individual.
Stripes extend across body, legs, and mane.
Robust muscular body.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Long slender legs terminating in single dark hooves.
Long tail with black tufted hair.

Head_and_Face: Large head with elongated snout ending in cartilaginous disk for rooting.
Small eyes.
Large floppy or erect ears depending on breed.
Body_and_Plumage: Stocky barrel-shaped body with variable size ranging from moderate to impressively massive.
Sparse coarse bristles over pink, black, or spotted skin.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Short stout legs with cloven hooves.

Head_and_Face: Large head with prominent elongated snout.
Males possess prominent curved tusks (enlarged canines) protruding from mouth.
Small dark eyes.
Pointed erect ears.
Body_and_Plumage: Robust body with heavily built, substantial proportions.
Coarse dark brown to black bristly fur over thick skin.
Dorsal ridge of stiff bristles forming mane.
Narrower body than domestic pig.

Head_and_Face: Large flattened head with distinctive warty protuberances on face (orbital and maxillary warts).
Prominent curved tusks protruding upward from lower jaw and outward from upper jaw.
Broad flat snout.
High-set eyes on head.
Large pointed ears.
Body_and_Plumage: Laterally compressed body with moderately large, substantial proportions.
Sparse coarse gray-brown bristles.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Relatively long legs for a suid.
Long thin tail with terminal tuft.

Head_and_Face: Enormous head comprising approximately one-third of body length with broad muzzle.
Eyes, ears, and nostrils positioned on top of head for semiaquatic lifestyle.
Extremely wide mouth with large tusk-like canines and incisors.
Body_and_Plumage: Massive barrel-shaped body with extraordinarily immense proportions.
Thick nearly hairless skin in gray-brown coloration.
Skin secretes reddish oily substance acting as sunscreen.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Short stubby legs with four webbed toes.

Head_and_Face: Broad head with wide muzzle.
Curved horns laterally and upward (if not dehorned).
Large dark eyes with wide field of vision.
Large mobile ears.
Thick muscular neck with prominent dewlap.
Body_and_Plumage: Massive muscular body with tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
Short dense coat in white, brown, black, or pied coloration.
Deep-chested body with strong back.

Head_and_Face: Elongated head with broad forehead.
Massive laterally curved horns triangular in cross-section with exceptionally broad span.
Dark eyes.
Relatively small ears.
Short thick neck.
Body_and_Plumage: Massive body with tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
Sparse dark gray to black hair over thick skin.
Deep barrel-shaped body.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Sturdy legs with broad cloven hooves adapted for wet terrain.

Head_and_Face: Large broad head with short curved horns.
Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
Dark eyes.
Small ears hidden in fur.
Body_and_Plumage: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
Hindquarters less heavily furred.
Short horns compared to body size.

Head_and_Face: Broad head with laterally spiraling horns (in horned breeds).
Thick ridged horns.
Dark eyes with horizontal rectangular pupils.
Lateral drooping ears.
Body_and_Plumage: Body covered with dense woolly fleece in white, brown, or black.
Compact stocky body with moderate to substantial proportions at the withers.
Thick muscular neck.
Short tail.

Head_and_Face: Broad head with large dark eyes.
Massive tightly curled horns of extraordinary weight with annual growth rings.
Horns curve laterally then downward and backward.
Short pointed ears.
Body_and_Plumage: Short brown to gray-brown coat with white rump patch.
Body with moderately tall, athletic proportions at the withers.
Muscular agile body adapted for mountainous terrain.
Short tail.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Sturdy legs with specialized hooves providing traction on rocky surfaces.
